quest.title: Yesterday's Tears, Tomorrow's Light
quest.description: You have a pleasant time and a fine night in the Fleuve Cendre. It is time to go and give the clothes you picked up to Adele.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x650, Primogem x60, Mora x47175, Guide to Equity x5, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Adele, we're back! We brought you a gift from the Court, too.

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: Whoa, thank you so much, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: Don't call her "Boss," okay, Adele? Just "Miss Navia" would be fine.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Haha, it's alright, I don't mind. Besides the gift, I've also got another surprise — guess who's here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hello again.

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you two! It has been a while indeed. Thank you so much for your help on Jacques' case.

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: I've heard that you also helped save all of Fontaine. You're truly just like the great heroes of legend.

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: You're really amazing, and if Miss Navia's your friend, then she must be super amazing too!

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: What's in this thing? Can I look?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Of course, go ahead!

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: Oh, it's... a Spina di Rosula uniform! Is it for me? But... Isn't it a bit big?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's a gift for future you. When you first told me that you were interested in joining the Spina, I was overjoyed.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: But it's the Spina's responsibility to protect everyone as well. Being a member means becoming involved in all kinds of dangerous situations, and since you're still young, I don't want your mom to have to worry about your safety.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: So I turned you down then by telling you that you'll have to wait until you're older. But this uniform is a promise that you can join us once you're old enough to wear it!

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: Ooh, so that's it! Well, thank you so much, Miss Navia! I'll work hard and grow up as fast as I can.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Haha, but you can't really grow up faster by working hard. You've got to be patient.

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: Everyone... I'm really grateful that you remembered my daughter's wish, and took it seriously.

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: Thanks to the protection of the Spina, even though her father's no longer with us, we've still felt plenty of warmth and security.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: It's the least we could do. As long as you live in Poisson, even if you're not an official member, you're still part of the family.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: B—Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Huh? Is something up, Florent?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: I've got something urgent to report! Romeuf and his folks have gathered outside Poisson, and even shipped in a huge pile of explosives!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: What!? Explosives? What do they want?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: It seems like they've been planning this for some time. We started investigating as soon as we received your letter yesterday.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: But Romeuf and his folks must have gotten wind as well, because they abandoned their former posts before we could even check on them.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: We investigated their tracks, and found out that they're after Poisson!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Could they have smartened up since we caught them red-handed at the Court?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Seems like they've got no interest in sitting down and talking at all. We should have gone straight to the Maison Gardiennage.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Sorry, I underestimated the situation. Well, too late now, I suppose. Florent, where are they keeping their explosives?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: On the hill to the east of Poisson, near the Clementine Line...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Wait, could that mean...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: They want to blow up the Clementine Line!?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Certainly sounds like it...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Romeuf and his followers hate the Spina and everything to do with Callas — and the aquabus was the source of their contention.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If they manage to blow up the aquabus line, all that rubble will come crashing down the hill and straight into Poisson!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Are they insane? There are tons of innocent people in Poisson!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We have to stop them.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah, if they've been planning this for ages, they're definitely not going to let this opportunity slip by.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: We have to issue an evacuation order to the townspeople, and get them as far away from the entrance as possible. That should save them from the worst of it...

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Let's get everyone onto our ship. That should be the safest place.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: My dear partner, can I leave the Clementine Line to you?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If the explosives do go off, not only would the people of Poisson be in danger, any aquabuses using the line would plummet to the ground.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Let's stop their insanity first, then settle the score with them!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Got it.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Leave it to us, Navia! Please stay safe, too!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Let's go, you two! We've got to act fast. Ms. Coralie, please take Adele to the ship...

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Watch out, Boss!

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: What do you think you're doing, Colter!?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Tch. I thought all the annoying little hindrances had left, but I still couldn't get rid of you.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: You mean... This was all a trick so that you'd be left alone with me? Colter, are you with Romeuf too?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I get it now. You knew about their plans all along. You only told us they were doing badly so that we'd drop our guard...

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Not quite. Though I share their positions on some issues, I've never cared for his more radical ideas.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: And that's because... Out of the entire Spina di Rosula, I only hate you! Only you, Navia!

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: You'd better stay close to me.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Romeuf promised me that he would leave Poisson alone if I could just take you out.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: But it was like you were glued at the hip to that pesky Traveler. You never gave me a chance to make my move...

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Romeuf has lost his patience. I didn't have to be here today, you know, but I swore that I'd kill you, even if it meant being buried with you in the rubble.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Why?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Only someone as clueless about the past as you would ask such a foolish question.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: You never saw the heyday of Spina di Rosula, nor did you ever live through the golden age of Poisson.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: But I... I saw it all, with my own eyes! And then I had to watch it all die, little by little!

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: And it was all because of you, Navia.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Clementine died because of you, Callas died because of you, Melus and Silver died because of you... and so many more, dead! Everyone dead, all because of you!

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: So the shock and grief you showed us before... That was an act, too.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Now you're catching on! I heard Melus was dead the moment I got out.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Did you know? Down there in that blasted Fortress, I spent a long time thinking about what happened, and resolving to apologize to Melus as soon as I got out.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Back then, because of that aquabus, we had a huge fallout. I was convinced that all he cared about was loyalty, and that he had completely lost his capacity for critical thinking.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: The years passed by in a blur after that. I thought I had finally begun to understand him, and that he could help me relive the good old days again...

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: But then, he died! And it was because of you again, Navia. It's always because of you!

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: I once loved the Spina and Poisson more than anyone else! But what is left now of either besides death and ruin? You've singlehandedly destroyed everything that was beautiful, everything I've ever loved!

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Don't listen to him, Boss. He's just spouting nonsense.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Have you ever considered that... Maybe the people around you don't actually care about you at all?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Have you ever considered that... Maybe you only get respect because you're Callas and Clementine's child? That you've never done anything worthy, that you're just a big nothing?

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Have you ever considered that... Maybe people don't stay in Poisson because of you, but only because they have such beautiful memories of the past, before you came!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: (Because if you do falter, there will inevitably come a time when you'll have to face the consequences. And when that time comes, those most precious to you really will throw themselves in front of you, and pay the price for your mistakes...)

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: (Yeah... looking back on it now as an adult, I can hardly believe how patient and kind everyone was.)

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: (But is that really why they support me? Is their kindness... real?)

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: Shut your mouth! I, for one, really like Miss Navia! And my mom loves her, too!

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: I don't know how to explain it, but I like her, and that's that!

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: I'm sure Mr. Melus would be extremely disappointed in you right now.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: You've somehow managed to pin the blame for every mistake and tragedy in our history on the Boss herself.

dialogues.speaker: Colter
dialogues.text: Get out of the way, Florent. I don't want to hurt you.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: You're gonna have to.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Boss, there's no time for this! Stop hesitating and get out of here before you get buried!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Maybe you think you're being the realist by painting the history of the Spina and Poisson like this.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: But the love that I've felt from everyone was just as real. I've felt it. They've helped me get to where I am.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: And even now, I will continue to believe in that love. So let me show you just how much I love the Spina di Rosula!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Florent, I'll leave the town to you. Summon the other members and help with the evacuation of the townspeople.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: If you find any of Colter's accomplices, subdue them quickly, and don't give them the chance to harm any ordinary civilians.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I can't allow my partner to face the danger on the Clementine Line alone.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Got it, Boss. I'm on it.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: ...Are you okay, Navia?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I don't know, but I have to go.

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: A short while earlier, you and Paimon dashed to the entrance of Poisson.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's hurry up there! We have to protect the Clementine Line.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: If they're gonna blow up the waterway, they must have planted the explosives next to the support pillars!

talks.objective: Head to the area below the waterway quickly

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: These must be the explosives, right? And this is the control mechanism... Uh, how can we disable it?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's too scared to touch any of this stuff...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? There's a strangely shaped hole here. What is it for?

choices.text: Could it be some kind of keyhole?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That certainly sounds possible... Maybe one of the people we just beat up has the key?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Okay, you take this side, Paimon will take the other, let's see what we can find!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That should do it, right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Phew... Navia and Florent should be able to relax now.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: We should still check out the perimeter, just in case.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're right, they could have set explosives elsewhere, too... Let's go!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Having been alerted, members of the Maison Gardiennage arrive at the scene a short time later, and take Romeuf and all of his followers into custody.

dialogues.speaker: Esmond
dialogues.text: I heard from Thierry that even they're your enemies now, they were once a part of Spina di Rosula. Do you plan to settle this privately with them?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I have nothing more to say to them.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Regardless of whether their hatred and anger towards me or the Spina was justified, anyone who's willing to endanger innocent civilians is no longer sane enough to even be worth trying to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Please prosecute them in accordance to the law. Spina di Rosula will not raise any objections.

dialogues.speaker: Esmond
dialogues.text: Sounds good. We're very appreciative of your help. Without it, the consequences would have been far worse.

dialogues.speaker: Esmond
dialogues.text: Alright, this operation is a wrap. Take 'em away!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We won, Navia! We saved everyone! And you were so cool!

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Yeah... Luckily, we were just in time...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Haha, it's probably because I expended too much elemental energy at once. Haha... I'll be fine. Don't worry about me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Aw, but you usually glow up whenever other people compliment you. Paimon's not used to seeing you like this.

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: Boss, we managed to catch all the infiltrators in the town. The Maison Gardiennage is taking them away as well.

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: Seems like Romeuf really went all in on this mission. If he sent literally everyone he had, though, that also means we've caught them all, too. We won't have to worry about them from now on.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Got it. That's good, at least.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Colter.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I can understand how you feel. The things that we lost... they're forever beyond our grasp now, and that makes them appear even more precious.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I am not Callas, and I will also never become him. The Spina and the Poisson that you loved are both gone.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: But I will not change how I feel about our future. I still believe that this is a great opportunity to start anew.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I will spend more of what the Spina earns on the betterment of Poisson. What's more, I'd also like to propose some changes to the aquabus routes...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: So that one day, the people of Poisson will enjoy the boons it brings as well.

response.speaker: Colter
response.text: I know what you're trying to say. Mr. Callas... would never have said anything like that.

response.speaker: Colter
response.text: There are too many things in life that are just beyond our control. In that, we are the same.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Henceforth, you are no longer a member of Spina di Rosula.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: But once you're discharged from the Fortress again, you're welcome to pay another visit to Poisson.

response.speaker: Colter
response.text: Thank you, Navia.

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: As I thought... Boss really is a kind and gentle person.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: ...She is also, I must say, a truly unlucky person.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Thank you for protecting the Clementine Line.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, I was actually really scared, you know. I mean, even the Callas Line won't be getting rebuilt anytime soon...

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: If I'd lost the Clementine Line too, I wouldn't know how to live with myself.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: A name is a way to etch a memory onto the world. Losing the line that bears her name, that I can see every day, would be like losing my mother all over again.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Seeing it still standing there, tall and proud... It makes me really happy.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What happened while we were gone? Honestly, you look more upset than tired or anything...

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: Just give her some time.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Mhm, thank you so much. Can you give me a hand? I really don't have much strength left.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: #{NICKNAME}... I want to ask you something. And please, tell me the truth.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Do you really see me as your "partner"?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Of course.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: That's good then.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hearing that... It brings me more relief than I can say.

choices.text: I'll get you back to Poisson.

talks.objective: Help Navia get back to Poisson

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: How do you feel, Navia? Any better after taking a break?

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Mhm, I feel quite a bit better, but I should probably still rest for a few more days.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Sorry, partner, I said some weird things earlier. Feel free to just ignore me.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: I used to think I'd never doubt myself, but you could say I've discovered that I'm not as strong as I thought I was.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Colter mentioned my parents, as well as Melus and Silver. It's all thanks to them that I've made it this far in life.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Do you think... they ever regretted the choices they made? Has my existence... made this world a better place?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Don't think like that, Navia, you've already done more than enough.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: No matter what others think, we'll always support you to the end of the world!

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: Well, since it's ended up like this, I suppose it's time for me to make a confession as well.

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: There's something that I've been keeping from you as well, Boss. Please follow me... Everything's already prepared.

response.speaker: Navia
response.text: Hey, Florent, I hope you can understand that I can't deal with any more "shocking revelations" right now.

response.speaker: Florent
response.text: Don't worry, this surprise will be a pleasant one.

choices.text: But that's because I've never heard you doubt yourself before.

talks.objective: Go with Navia to see the "surprise"

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Why is everyone gathered here? And what's... this?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: This was supposed to be a gift to you from everyone in town. We were originally planning to show it to you once it was finished...

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: But special times call for special measures. I've never seen you look so defeated before, so I've decided to show you the designs before the final product was done.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I... Do I really look that bad?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: Well, if you're ready, I'll unveil the present.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Mhm...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Th—This is...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Papa, Mother, and... me...

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: We designed the look for Ms. Clementine based on old Kamera records, as well as personal recollections from the members of the Spina.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wow, this is the statue you mentioned before!?

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: It is indeed. To be honest, we decided on the design a long time ago, and gave the sculptor permission to begin working.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: We only asked Boss to decide on a design so she wouldn't realize we had already started.

dialogues.speaker: Yvette
dialogues.text: How could we only have statues of Mr. Callas and Mrs. Clementine?

dialogues.speaker: Sandino
dialogues.text: Even though Boss is still young, we've all seen the work she's put in regarding the whole Sinthe business and the rebuilding of Poisson.

dialogues.speaker: Archenoul
dialogues.text: We wanted to commemorate her contributions with a statue as well.

dialogues.speaker: Adele
dialogues.text: I don't know what Spina di Rosula was like in the past, but I know it's a great organization now!

dialogues.speaker: Coralie
dialogues.text: With Navia around, we're not worried about this place's future.

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: We're gathered here today to tell our Boss—

dialogues.speaker: Florent
dialogues.text: That we support you and believe in you wholeheartedly. I believe everyone's here for you, not the glory days.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's what we believe as well!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I will also always believe in the bond between us.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: Thank you so much, everyone... Then I'll be brave and just accept everyone's support for what it is...

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: This really is quite the surprise.

dialogues.speaker: Navia
dialogues.text: I never thought that I'd have the chance to stand next to my mother... Not even in my wildest dreams.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let me turn this guy over... Oof, he's super heavy... He could probably eat a whole Paimon just for breakfast...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's turn off the device right now... We're running out of time!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, you found it! That's amazing!
